description: This file contains helper routines for configuring and unconfiguring network interfaces, including functions to get network portions of IPs, retrieve MAC addresses, increment MAC addresses, convert IPv4 to IPv6 format, and configure VLANs.
external_files: sysevent command (likely a system service or script for event management)

methods.name: get_network
methods.description: Extracts and returns the network portion of an IP address assuming a subnet mask of 255.255.255.0.

methods.name: get_mac
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of a specified network interface.

methods.name: incr_mac
methods.description: Increments a MAC address by a given amount.

methods.name: convert_v4_2_v6
methods.description: Converts an IPv4 address into its IPv6 4-octet hexadecimal format.

methods.name: config_vlan
methods.description: Configures a network interface into a VLAN with specified VLAN ID, setting up necessary parameters and MAC address handling.

methods.name: unconfig_vlan
methods.description: Removes VLAN configuration from a specified VLAN ID.
